reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: liquidation_inner (defined at market.move:691) has 3 non-test callers (lines 530, 597, 663) and code at line 774 is reachable. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; attack vector is an external untrusted liquidator. Gate 3: contracts/protocol/sources/internal/market/market.move is explicitly in scope and liquidation logic is a listed focus area. An attacker can trigger this via the liquidation entry point by repaying exactly close_factor * debt, leaving remaining debt < min_borrow_amount, causing unrecoverable bad debt accumulation for the protocol — the enforce_post_borrow_repay_invariant check present on borrow (line 413) and repay (line 470) paths is entirely absent from liquidation_inner.
